content.opening: I am excited to apply for the Senior Product Designer position at Northstar Labs. Your focus on making complex collaboration feel simple closely matches the work I have led throughout my career.
body: At Atlas Software, I led the redesign of a multi-team planning workflow used by enterprise customers. I mapped the end-to-end journey, tested a unified interaction model, and aligned product and engineering around a phased release. The result reduced time-to-completion by 32% and lowered support volume.
content.closingParagraph: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could help Northstar turn ambitious workflow ideas into clear, durable experiences.
